item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"sequence_modeling","rationale":"Halve the configured maximum context length, rounding down with a minimum of one, to reduce stale-history noise. Existing sampling retains recent interactions in chronological order with unchanged padding and positional conventions. Saved maxlen metadata already makes the generated predictor use the same context length and positional embedding shape.","edits":[{"find":"MAXLEN       = int(os.environ.get(\"SASREC_MAXLEN\",    \"128\"))","replace":"MAXLEN       = max(1, int(os.environ.get(\"SASREC_MAXLEN\", \"128\")) // 2)"}]}],"change_summary":"Reduce default SASRec context from 128 to 64 consistently across training, validation, checkpoints, and generated prediction through existing maxlen plumbing."}
